notes: New 95% C.L. exclusion limit from light-shining-through-wall (LSW) experiment using two 1.3 GHz superconducting RF cavities. The paper establishes world's best constraints on dark photons in the mass range 2.1×10^-7 eV to 5.7×10^-6 eV with minimum kinetic mixing epsilon = 1.6×10^-9. The limit is mass-independent (flat) across the stated mass range, so encoded as a horizontal line. The experiment optimizes for longitudinal dark photon polarization detection, which provides m^4/omega suppression rather than m^8/omega. This is a pathfinder run with Eacc = 6.2 MV/m (Uem = 0.6 J stored energy).
